name: Millionaire Monster Penthouse
source:
Welcome to Millionaire Monster Penthouse, an immersive romance adventure where luxury meets the supernatural! You’ve just scored your dream job in a breathtaking penthouse with a free luxury condo in the heart of the city. Everything seems perfect—until you discover that your high-end clients aren’t just wealthy elites, but supernatural beings with ancient, powerful bloodlines.

Thrust into the secret world of demons, spirits, and creatures beyond your imagination, you uncover that you’re the heir to a demon clan, with a destiny that ties you to this otherworldly world. With three dangerously attractive monsters vying for your attention, can you balance your new supernatural life, a chaotic job, and your heart’s desires?

Will you give in to the charms of a cocky shinigami, a stoic werewolf, or a mysterious phantom? Your choices will determine your fate in this dark fantasy romance!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.monsterpenthouse]Google Play[/url]]
